description:
MOT statistics for the whole GB fleet, from the RegTail MOT Index 2025 (DVSA anonymised MOT data, Open Government Licence v3.0). Answers: how often a model passes its MOT, what fails and what gets advisories, how it compares with all cars, by age, fuel and mileage, and how a model at a given age compares with all cars of that age (pass age). Free, no account or credit needed, read-only. Beta: the figures are final for this release, field names may still change.

Aggregate figures, not a check of any particular car: for one car use the plate tools. Pass node as a stable id: overview, index (every node id), postcode, release, model/{make}/{model} (e.g. model/ford/fiesta), make/{make}, defect/{slug}; a page URL or a name like 'Ford Fiesta' also works. year is 2023, 2024, 2025 or latest. view='full' adds the long lists.

Returns summary (one sentence), data (rates are fractions 0 to 1; failure and advisory rates are floors, say 'at least'; fuel, mileage-band and postcode figures are not age-adjusted), evidence (sources, as-of, population, uncertainty, insufficient_data with its reason when a year has too few tests: then say there are not enough tests, never give a number), links, edges (the next nodes, what each answers, free, thin) and citation. Cite it as DVSA anonymised MOT data. It does not check outstanding finance, stolen or write-off status.
